Partner fit

Built for serious partner-side leaders, not lead-volume campaigns.

The best fit is a company selling AI, data, security, infrastructure, or related enterprise capability where executive trust matters more than raw lead count.

Built for

Leaders who need executive trust.

Field marketing, alliances, CMO, CRO, founder, and executive leaders who need credibility with senior enterprise decision-makers.

Partner tiers

A clear path from candidate to strategic partner.

Organizations move through the partner model by increasing their useful contribution to virtual events, executive sessions, research outputs, the six Mojo AI Summits cohorts, and the long-term institution.

Entry stage

Partner Candidate

An organization exploring fit before formal partnership. Partner Candidates are invited into selected conversations to demonstrate relevance, executive credibility, and a contribution-first posture.

  • Observe or contribute to selected executive conversations
  • Share practical, non-promotional market perspective
  • Prove strategic fit before broader access
Tier 01

Research Partner

A Partner contributing to the intelligence layer through research themes, private briefs, real-world examples, field observations, and useful executive perspective.

  • Inform quarterly intelligence briefs
  • Receive editorial review of intelligence briefs
  • Contribute practical examples and patterns from the field
  • Participate in research and editorial synthesis
  • Access discounts on virtual event executive subscriptions
Tier 02

Summit Partner

A partner with a meaningful role in the annual summit experience, helping shape problem rooms, executive sessions, and the public expression of the year's intelligence.

  • Support annual summit programming
  • Contribute to problem-solving rooms
  • Receive editorial review of summit briefs
  • Participate in summit and yearbook outputs
  • Access discounts on summit executive subscriptions
Tier 03

Strategic Partner

A senior Partner designation for organizations engaged across the other types of executive engagement Mojo may create beyond virtual events and summit attendance. Strategic Partner access becomes available in Q2 2027.

  • Engage across eligible executive engagement formats beginning in Q2 2027
  • Make an early institution-building commitment
  • Help define the partner trust model
  • Receive yearbook editorial review
  • Receive permanent founding recognition
  • Access discounts on eligible Mojo executive subscriptions and specialty events once Strategic Partner access opens
Partnership level does not automatically grant individual fellowship status. Executives earn recognition through contribution to the network; organizations earn Partner standing through strategic fit, useful expertise, and trust-preserving participation.
